This question evaluates end-to-end understanding of multi-tenant isolation, Azure App Configuration integration, and lightweight caching within an Azure Function. It also tests practical CI/CD knowledge across dev/stage/prod environments and the ability to validate per-tenant behavior.

- Managed Identity for secure access to App Configuration
- In-memory TTL cache per tenant (300 seconds) for flag data
- Header-based tenant identification for request routing
